type: topic

---
name: bom-line-start
﻿type: topic
visibility: normal
---
A U+FEFF opening a line inside the block: SafeLoader keeps it in the key; libyaml rejects the block.

name: bom-own-line
type: topic
﻿
visibility: normal
---
